newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's LG-Caltex starts reformer operation.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's LG-Caltex starts reformer operation.

text.p: South Korea's LG-Caltex Oil Corp said on Wednesday it had started commercial operation of its new 35,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) naphtha reformer.
This will bring LG-Caltex's total naphtha reforming capacity to 59,000 bpd, the largest in the country, a company statement said.
The refiner has invested 170 billion won since March 1995, when it started construction of the new unit, it said.

LG-Caltex is a joint venture between LG Group and Caltex Petroleum Corp, itself a joint venture between U.S. oil giants Texaco Inc and Chevron Corp. It has the nation's second-largest refining capacity of 600,000 bpd.
